best_for: Developers and database admins working with Redis, Redis Cloud or Azure Managed Redis who want to browse keys, profile commands and build search queries in a desktop GUI.

points.title: Free, but not open source
points.text: Redis Insight costs nothing. Its code is under the SSPL, which Flathub does not count as a free software license.

points.title: See and edit your data
points.text: Browse keys grouped by namespace and create, edit or delete strings, lists, hashes, sets, sorted sets, streams, JSON and vector sets. Values can be shown as JSON, MessagePack, HEX and more.

points.title: Find what is slow
points.text: A profiler shows every command in real time, the Slow Log lists slow commands, and database analysis shows memory by type and top keys. The analysis checks up to 10,000 keys and estimates beyond that.

points.title: Copilot needs a sign-in
points.text: The Redis Copilot AI chat, which can turn plain questions into search queries, works only after you sign in and accept its terms. Telemetry is opt-in.

points.title: Not only a desktop app
points.text: The same tool runs as a Docker image or on Kubernetes, and a Redis for VS Code extension brings browsing into the editor.

points.title: Platforms differ here
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 2 versions and is at 3.4.2. macOS is at 3.10.0, with Intel and Apple silicon disk images for macOS 12 or later. The Linux Flatpak is at 3.8.0 and is marked verified by Flathub as published by Redis.
